2176. Reverse an Array Using Pointers

50

Medium

Write a C program to reverse the elements of an array using pointers.

Your program should:

Read an integer N representing the number of elements.

Read N integers into an array.

Pass the address of the first and last elements to a function named  reverseArray() .

Reverse the array by swapping elements using pointers.

Print the reversed array.
input_spec:
First line contains an integer N.

Second line contains N space-separated integers.
output_spec:
Print the array elements in reverse order, separated by spaces
